name: CDMS
summary: CDMS was an early programme of cryogenic germanium/silicon dark-matter detectors, first operated at a shallow Stanford site and later at Soudan. CDMS-II results are recorded separately from its successor SuperCDMS.
detection_principle: Ionization and lattice phonons from scattering are measured together. Their ratio and pulse timing reject electron and surface-event backgrounds.

results.summary: The candidate-event statistics were insufficient to establish a WIMP discovery. Subsequent results must retain their individual target materials and datasets.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
